title: Error Reporting, Cloud Trace and Cloud Profiler

videos.script: A metric tells you something is wrong. It does not tell you where. {{where}} Three tools look inside. Error Reporting gathers the same failure into one row, with a count. Four thousand errors become one bug. {{errors}} Cloud Trace follows one request across services. It shows which step took the time. {{trace}} Cloud Profiler looks inside the process itself. Which function eats the CPU? {{profiler}} All three need a little help from your code. A stack trace inside one log entry. A header passed along to the next service. A version name on every report. {{help}} You will write the error entry yourself, and group it by hand. {{end}}
